title: Design System: Lab Trxckin assistant surface

shadows.name: header-panel
shadows.purpose: Fixed assistant panel over the current module.

motion.name: activity-pulse
motion.purpose: Tool progress and thinking dots; opacity 0.45 to 1.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation: none !important; transition: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important
motion.purpose: Applied inside assistant scope for prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. The explicit JavaScript smooth-scroll control remains a limitation, not a normative reduced-motion behavior.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Light-theme action from the scoped assistant source; no unimplemented hover transform.
components.css: .ds-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 38px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; font: 14px/1.5 Ubuntu, sans-serif; color: #fff; background: #1c355b; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .16s, color .16s; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5785c3; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: Quiet modal action using the soft surface.
components.css: .ds-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 38px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; font: 14px/1.5 Ubuntu, sans-serif; color: #16243c; background: #edf2f8; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .16s, color .16s; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5785c3; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-secondary:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Send action
components.description: Icon-only send action. The product replaces it with Stop during a run.
components.html: <button class="ds-send" aria-label="Enviar consulta"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m5 12 7-7 7 7"/><path d="M12 19V5"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-send { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 34px; height: 34px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: #1c355b; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .16s, color .16s; } .ds-send:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(1.16); } .ds-send:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5785c3; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-send:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; } @media(max-width: 600px) { .ds-send { width: 44px; height: 44px; } } @media(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-send { transition: none; } }

components.name: Composer field
components.description: Multiline field, inside its full-width rounded composer enclosure. Toolbar is described in the surface record.
components.css: .ds-composer { max-width: 780px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; transition: border-color .18s; } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color: #7997bf; } .ds-prompt { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; display: block; resize: none; min-height: 68px; max-height: 180px; border: 0; outline: none; box-shadow: none; background: transparent; padding: 16px 17px 5px; font: 14px/1.65 Ubuntu, sans-serif; color: #16243c; caret-color: #1c355b; } .ds-prompt::placeholder { font-size: 13px; color: #5c6c83; opacity: 1; } @media(max-width: 767px) { .ds-prompt { font-size: 16px; } } @media(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-composer { transition: none; } }

components.name: Result group
components.description: Evidence enclosure and its heading; compact metadata is deliberately not made a preview type-scale rule.
components.css: .ds-result { border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; margin: 9px 0 15px; background: #fff; color: #16243c; font-family: Ubuntu, sans-serif; } .ds-result-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; padding: 12px 14px; background: #f7f9fc; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; } .ds-result-heading strong { font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Persistent demo notice
components.description: The fictional-data disclosure remains below the composer in empty and populated states.
components.html: Datos de demostración; empresas y registros ficticios.
components.css: .ds-demo-notice { display: block; font: 12px/1.45 Ubuntu, sans-serif; margin-bottom: 3px; color: #16243c; text-align: center; text-wrap: balance; }

narrative.overview:
The assistant extends the existing Ubuntu, navy navigation, company accent and light/dark interface. Its direction is a private working conversation beside the records that support it. It is an operational surface: reading, asking, checking sources and returning to authorized module detail views take precedence over decoration.

This is a scoped implementation record, not a replacement global `DESIGN.md`. The approved workflow was code-led, with no generated or approved image comp and no new visual world. The source is authoritative; retained screenshots document the reviewed result. The three-column composition belongs to this assistant, not to every page in Lab Trxckin.
keyCharacteristics: A readable central answer, with history and evidence as independently collapsible desktop rails.
Quiet tonal surfaces and thin boundaries; colour indicates company scope, action or state.
Persistent fictional-data disclosure and visible source scope/completeness.
One conversation and composer state shared between the full page and header panel.

rules.name: The Company Scope Rule
rules.body: Keep the company indicator beside the conversation's scope label; do not infer the frozen scope from an action colour.

rules.name: The Composer Continuity Rule
rules.body: Moving between panel and page preserves the selected conversation, draft, model, response language and current run; choosing another conversation or actor follows the provider's explicit reset rules.

rules.name: The Temporary Depth Rule
rules.body: Reuse the existing modal elevation for overlays; use tone and borders for ordinary conversation and evidence content.

dos: Do reuse the scoped light/dark colour roles and the incumbent Ubuntu face.
Do preserve the composer, reachable rail controls and internal table scrolling at narrow widths and short heights.
Do show source scope, incomplete coverage, accessible state text and the persistent fictional-data label.
Do use human-readable business labels and evidence-backed links in both displayed and copied answers.
donts: Don't turn this assistant's three-column composition or local tokens into an unapproved global app system.
Don't imply that a partial query covers every record or that a fictional demonstration represents a real company.
Don't add business mutation, attachment content, upload, export, web-search or spoken-answer controls to this read-only surface without a new feature decision.
Don't promote existing small metadata declarations or the explicit smooth-scroll limitation into rules for future components.
